many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def split_fixed(I):
    I=np.array(I); cnt=Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    c=[j for j in range(I.shape[1]) if len(set(I[:,j]))==1 and I[0,j]!=cnt]
    r=[i for i in range(I.shape[0]) if len(set(I[i,:]))==1 and I[i,0]!=cnt]
    if c: return I[:,:c[0]],I[:,c[0]+1:]
    else: return I[:r[0]],I[r[0]+1:]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    A,B=split_fixed(G[k+' input']); O=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    aa=(A!=Counter(A.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]); bb=(B!=Counter(B.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0])
    H,W=A.shape
    best=[]
    for dy in range(-H,H):
        for dx in range(-W,W):
            P=np.zeros_like(aa)
            ys,xs=np.where(bb)
            pts=[(y+dy,x+dx) for y,x in zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist())]
            inside=[p for p in pts if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W]
            if not inside: continue
            Ps=set(inside); inter=len(Ps & set(zip(*np.where(aa))))
            if inter>max([len(z) for z in [()] ]+[0]):
                pass
            # measure agreement between translated B-mask and O
            M=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
            for p in inside: M[p[0]][p[1]]=True
            agr=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if (M[i][j]==O[i][j]==2))
            miss=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if M[i][j]^O[i][j])
            best.append((miss,dy,dx,int(agr)))
    best.sort(); print(k,'best translate-B-vs-O:',best[:3],'|A|',int(aa.sum()),'|B|',int(bb.sum()),'|O|',int((O==2).sum()))

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
G=load()
def regs(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape; cnt=Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    r=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(I[i,:]))==1 and I[i,0]!=cnt]
    c=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(I[:,j]))==1 and I[0,j]!=cnt]
    if r: return I[:r[0]],I[r[0]+1:],('H')
    else: return I[:,:c[0]],I[:,c[0]+1:],('V')
# broad predicate search on all demos: compare transformed B-mask vs O, allowing shifts of +-1 only
preds=[]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 8']:
    I=np.array(G[k+' input']); O=np.array(G[k+' output']); A,B,_=regs(I)
    bga=Counter(A.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]; bgb=Counter(B.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Na=A!=bga; Nb=B!=bgb
    res=[]
    # predicate families
    fam={'AND':lambda M,N:M&N,'XOR':lambda M,N:M^N,'NOR':lambda M,N:(~M)&(~N),'ONLYA':lambda M,N:M&~N,'ONLYB':lambda M,N:N&~M,
         'AeqB':lambda M,N:M==N,'neq':lambda M,N:M!=N,'gt1':lambda M,N:(M+N)>1,'ADD':lambda M,N:M+N}
    for nm,F in fam.items():
        best=(10**9,None)
        for name,Ft in [('id',lambda x:x),('lr',np.fliplr),('ud',np.flipud),('r90',lambda x:np.rot90(x)),('r90-1',lambda x:np.rot90(x,-1))]:
            N=Ft(Nb)
            q=F(Na,N) if Ft.__name__ in [] else F(Na,Ft(Nb))
            res.append((k,nm,name,int(np.sum(q*2!=O))))
    preds.append((k,res))
    print(k, sorted([(d,nm,name) for d,nm,name in res])[:5])
